title: Agent state contract — agents/<agent_id>/state.json
description: Define and implement the persistent agent state contract. Each agent identity gets a state.json file at agents/<agent_id>/state.json with fields: assigned_role, current_task, workload_counters (runs_started, stages_completed), last_active_at. Create a JSON schema for validation. Provide read/write utility functions that enforce the schema. The state file is created on first assignment and updated on every stage transition.
stop_condition: Agent state files are created, read, and updated with schema validation. Workload counters increment on stage transitions.
